Write an R list to a TreePPL JSON input file

Source: R/data.R
tp_write_tppl_json.Rd

Writes x with the JSON settings TreePPL needs: length-1 vectors become plain values ("rho": 0.5, not "rho": [0.5]), numbers keep their full precision, and the file is indented so it is easy to read.

Usage

tp_write_tppl_json(x, file)

Arguments

x

A named list, one element per model argument.

file

Path of the JSON file to write.

Value

file, invisibly.

Details

Each top-level element of x must be named exactly like an argument of the model function (see tp_expected_input()). A vector of length 1 that must stay an array, such as an Int[] with a single value, has to be wrapped in I().

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
phy <- ape::read.tree(text = "((A:4,B:4):6,(C:7,D:7):3);")
tp_write_tppl_json(
  x = list(tree = tp_phylo_to_tpPhylo(phy), rho = 0.5),
  file = "testdata_crbd.json"
)
} # }
